messages:
Devon (Head of Product): Quick follow-up thread for today's all-hands — posting the top clarifications about the reorg, hiring, and IC/manager paths. I'll loop in people who can answer. Please keep Qs short so we can triage.

Priya (Eng Manager): Thanks. Can we get clarity on whether team ownership (product + platform) changes affect on-call rotations?

Chris (VP Eng): Short answer: no immediate change to on-call schedules. Ops ownership moves will be phased; we'll publish a mapping by Friday. If your team ships a runtime change that affects infra, we'll coordinate a temporary cross-team pager for rollout windows.

Leo (SWE): Will ongoing offers still go through? I had an offer in final stage with a candidate in interviews.

Anita (People Ops): Yes — offers already in final stage will proceed. New reqs go through the prioritization queue. If you have a candidate stuck in loop, DM me and I'll escalate.

Sanjay (Finance): To add: Hiring is not a full freeze anymore. We have a constrained hiring envelope for Q2 focused on infra, reliability, and customer success. Requests outside those buckets will need a rubric review.

Devon (Head of Product): @Chris — can you clarify manager headcount expectations? Feels like a lot of ICs asking about new manager hires.

Chris (VP Eng): We're prioritizing 1-2 new senior manager slots for teams with >10 direct ICs or critical ownership gaps. New managers will be matched to teams based on product criticality and growth trajectory, not purely tenure.

Priya (Eng Manager): On leveling — will IC ladder changes land with the org chart or be separate? A few folks asked about L4->L5 criteria.

Anita (People Ops): Leveling updates will be a separate rollout. We'll share a matrix and FAQ next week. For folks in-flight on promotions, we will honor prior time-based backfills; promotions already in HR flow won't be reversed.

Leo (SWE): Is there an ETA for the final org chart? Our team needs to update ROADMAP ownership for next sprint.

Devon (Head of Product): Finalized org chart by EOD next Wednesday. We'll also attach a CSV mapping old->new owners for quick grep.

Priya (Eng Manager): Will there be office hours for 1:1 clarifications? Some of my reports want private chats.

Anita (People Ops): Yes — scheduling three 30-min open hours next Thursday (9:30, 12:00, 15:30 PT). I'll post a Calendly link here. Private 1:1s should go through managers or People Ops.

Maria (CEO): Quick note — reorg intent: reduce cross-team handoffs and clarify model/product ownership. We aim to avoid forcing moves; we'll prioritize voluntary transitions and shadowing for 6 weeks before formal reassignment.

Leo (SWE): Shadowing sounds good. How will performance reviews account for shadowed work?

Chris (VP Eng): Review cycles remain the same. Managers should annotate contributions during shadowing in the review packet. No surprises.

Devon (Head of Product): A few operational items:
- We'll create a single source doc "org-ownership-mapping" in the handbook.
- If your team's roadmap is blocked, tag #roadmap-hold and @Devon.
- For hiring prioritization, use the new form at /hire-request.

Priya (Eng Manager): Can we get the hiring rubric link here?

Recruiter Bot: Automated: hiring rubric and intake form -> https://internal.redwood/hiring/rubric (access: all-hands). Use tag: hiring-q2.

Sanjay (Finance): Also - heads-up: approved reqs must include cost-center and expected start quarter in the form. This speeds approvals.

Leo (SWE): For folks considering internal moves, any guidance on notice period?

Anita (People Ops): Standard notice is 2 weeks for ICs; for internal transfers we'll try to do a 1-2 sprint overlap with outgoing manager to transfer knowledge. We'll work with teams to find the smoothest dates.

Devon (Head of Product): Final: we'll compile these Qs + answers into the all-hands follow-up doc and pin to the channel. If anyone has a sensitive question, DM Anita or Maria directly. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

Recruiter Bot: Doc published: https://internal.redwood/all-hands/1729999999-followup (contains org CSV, hiring rubric, office hours link)
